data_fields.name: murder_jail_score
data_fields.donor_constant: 20 (jail minutes per murder evidence, before infamy term)

data_fields.name: infamy_step
data_fields.donor_constant: 1000 (infamy per jail multiplier step, integer division in donor)

best_idea: A crime meter fills when evidence is reported, sets a wanted tag at a low threshold and an escalated state at a high lifetime total, is cleared by any verdict, and sets jail time from the evidence list scaled by the jury tally.
decision_why: The two-threshold meter with clear-on-verdict fits our open PvP flag and murder counts; the jury trial is too heavy for phone-first, so keep only the sentence table as data, and fix the donor's meter wrap and integer infamy step.
acceptance: A player whose reported murders reach 50 points gets a visible Wanted badge and can be arrested by a player on their next death; a server test asserts 3 murders of 20 points give meter 60 and wanted true, infamy 3000 sets the escalated state, a not-guilty verdict removes the counted points from infamy, and adding 40000 points caps the meter at 32767.
